shields_note: Posted in the starting section as '(10 Shields, mainly just coward, grabber, Fanfare and SAC stopper)', outside the 60; only Come Here You Big Coward ('coward') and Fanfare are named. The 'grabber' and 'SAC stopper' shields are not identifiable, so they are not linked.
notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting(9): Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Throne Room, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Prepared Defenses, Colo Claw Fish, Crush The Rebellion, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Fear Is My Ally; these count toward the 60.

Posted 'Death Star 2 War Room' dested Death Star II: Throne Room: no Death Star II War Room exists, Bring Him Before Me deploys the Throne Room, and the strategy says to set up 'Palpy at the Throne Room'.

Posted 'DRE and Snoop' (a Dr. Dre & Snoop Dogg joke) dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'Coruscant Docking Bay(Cor)' dested the Coruscant-set Dark Coruscant: Docking Bay; 'Death Star 2 Docking Bay' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay.
Posted 'BHBM/TYFP', 'IAO/Secret Plans', 'Evader/ Monnok' and 'Sniper/ Dark Strike' dested as the objective and combo cards; 'w/' character names dested the 'With' cards.
The strategy praises Inconsequential Barriers, but it is not in the posted list, so it is not added.
The byline spells the surname 'brown'; the player is credited as Jonathan Brown.
